$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId pins the actor created by the first deploy (2026-11-10, build 1.0.1), so a rename keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Y Combinator Jobs Scraper - Salary, Equity & Visa
seoDescription: Search every open job at YC startups on Work at a Startup by title, batch, place and pay. Get salary, equity, visa terms and the exact posting date.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 1 GB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-10 (build 1.0.2), the same three inputs at 512 MB and 1 GB: software engineer 63 s $0.00252 vs 47 s $0.00335, the daily test (maxJobs 100) 94 s $0.00370 vs 39 s $0.00319, founding engineer in San Francisco 61 s $0.00232 vs 41 s $0.00293. 1 GB is 42% faster on average (73 s to 42 s) for 11% more cost: every run reads 1,500 job lists and is CPU-bound on a small share of a core. One start event covers up to 1 GB, so the user pays the same at both; the daily test keeps 261 s of its 300 s. 2 GB took 21 s ($0.00305) but charges two start events. Timeout 1800 s: every open job (6,189) took 279 s.

pricing.$comment: Cost plus markup (owner, 2026-11-10, BRIEF section 10): FREE 100%, BRONZE 95%, SILVER 90%, GOLD 85%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 80% over the measured Apify cost at each tier's unit prices (docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md: compute $0.2/$0.2/$0.16/$0.13 per CU), rounded up to two significant figures, never under $0.00001. Fit on 8 runs at 1 GB (cCOBMBynJqBTe4DpI, 8e9mRcpT78N1iegxS, QHwkGVYd98hQCrHK6, dV2GpaW6w6KTJLAS6, RifJcaxKUa3QAlU6w, iGHpKKFswtaOQdYxY, 8HCioRxfrYTKRVPUa, DRIDnbIvYr3zodxoc): a run costs $0.00278 + $0.00000741 a job at FREE unit prices ($0.00230 + $0.00000647 SILVER, $0.00192 + $0.00000563 GOLD); a job with details costs the same (1,000 jobs with and without details: $0.010156 and $0.010447), so both events carry one price. Markup per event: FREE 105%, BRONZE 105%, SILVER 98%, GOLD 99%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 99% (set to GOLD's price: Apify stores them at GOLD's, batch 2, 2026-11-08). The run start, flat on every tier, would be $0.007 for 100% over the fixed cost; it is raised to $0.015 so the sparse run (rust searched in descriptions, 12 jobs from 2,806 calls, $0.006325, eK6QpW2VuqEmX9wP5) clears 80% on every tier: 92.6% on BRONZE; every other measured run, at 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB, clears 107% or more. Written from notes/price.py.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, remote or office, role, YC batch, pay and equity, visa terms, experience, team size, exact posting date and link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, whether it offers equity, and the city, state and country of its first place. The same price as a Job row.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
